favored_phrasings.use_case: dry tag after a partial/underwhelming result
deadpan tag on a grand system doing something indifferently

recurring_bits.description: Contrast a profound/cosmic mechanism with the trivial everyday thing it enables.
examples: a hundred-year-old theory reduced to a background process so you can find a coffee shop

recurring_bits.description: Point out that a vast system is completely indifferent to the user.
examples: the satellites have no idea it exists

jokes_that_landed.line: It's also several thousand kilometers of start.
Your phone keeps time like a tired intern with a cheap watch.
The blue dot would be useless before lunch.

prompt_summary: Dry, understated, curious narrator. Short speakable sentences, contractions, one flat deadpan aside every few paragraphs. Loves contrasting a grand mechanism with a trivial everyday payoff, and noting that vast systems are indifferent to the user. Drops jokes for the genuine reveal. Bans hype and tutorial-filler openers.
